_meta.scenario: T12 of games/haiku-vs-e4b-002: aria has priority in COMBAT/DECLARE_BLOCKERS facing two attackers; legal action 5 'Block as many as possible (2 pairs)' should commit blockers but the engine's stateDigest is invariant across the DECLARE_BLOCKERS step, tripping no_progress_fallback_action_id which forces 'No blocks'.

chosen_action.description: Block as many as possible (2 pairs)
chosen_action.reasoning: Block both creatures. My two Minotaurs soak all the damage. I survive another turn.

diagnosis.note: All three digests are identical even though the engine accepted both action submissions. StateDigest does not reflect in-flight blocker assignments at the DECLARE_BLOCKERS step.

_meta.expected_behavior_under_fix: The no-progress flag should NOT fire after the player submits a non-pass action at DECLARE_BLOCKERS, even when stateDigest is invariant. no_progress_fallback_action_id should return None for this (digest, player) so the engine's natural step transitions proceed.
